subject: planner: remove some function pointers (#64015)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent. Change is a refactor removing indirection via function pointers: (1) single-scan / index-covering helpers moved from `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go` into methods on `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop/DataSource` and call sites updated; (2) stats helpers (`GetStatsTable`, `LoadTableStats`, `GetTblInfoForUsedStatsByPhysicalID`) extracted from `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go` + `pkg/planner/core/stats.go` into new `pkg/planner/core/stats` package, with physical plans updated to call `stats.LoadTableStats`; (3) `getStatsTable` debug-trace code moved from `pkg/planner/core/debugtrace.go` to `pkg/planner/core/stats/debug_trace.go`. The moved logic matches the pre-refactor implementations (no semantic deltas observed in the relevant hot paths), and a quick scan of later upstream history touching these files did not reveal a dedicated follow-up fix indicating a missed Blocker/High regression.
